## 7. Deployment Strategies: Use Case {.use-case-slide}

::: {.use-case-card}
### Example prompt

Plan a phased operator rollout that starts with broad coverage and evolves toward higher capacity in the most demanding areas.

### Expected student task

- Prioritize the first deployment phase.
- Explain when densification becomes necessary.
- Connect the rollout order to demand and economics.
- Identify where sharing reduces risk.
:::
